title: Provenance-state changes require machine-checkable transition records

observed: CM-1023 defines coverage_state and origin_state as independent axes and lists required transition-record fields.
The active queue still requires exhaustive history coverage and immutable origin provenance for M-004, M-005, and M-006.
Before this slice, the required transition fields were not enforced by a repository schema.
inferred: A prose-only transition can silently omit prior rejection reasons, immutable locators, privacy classification, or falsification routes.
A schema does not prove a transition is true, but it prevents structurally incomplete records from being treated as authoritative.
proposed: Validate every future M-004, M-005, or M-006 state transition against operations/continuity/schemas/provenance-state-transition.schema.json.
Require at least one triggering evidence item and one immutable locator for every transition.
Require exhaustive_reproduced coverage and retained rejection reasons before unlocated_after_exhaustive_coverage is structurally admissible.
Require predicate deltas before verified is structurally admissible.
superseded: Treating a narrative status update as sufficient evidence of a provenance-state transition.
Allowing transition records to discard prior rejection reasons or omit falsification routes.
unresolved: The schema has not yet been wired into a repository test or CI gate.
No exhaustive ref-and-history manifest has been retained.
No origin candidate for M-004, M-005, or M-006 has passed every origin predicate.

included: repository commit, blob, and path locators
predicate and coverage deltas without private source payloads
abstract rejection reasons and falsification routes

verification.method: Fetched the schema from its exact commit and confirmed the required fields, state enums, privacy classes, evidence classes, and conditional constraints.
limitations: No JSON Schema validator was executed in this connector-only run.
Structural validity does not establish semantic truth, exhaustive coverage, or origin authenticity.

falsification_routes: Produce a structurally complete transition that the schema rejects despite conforming to CM-1023.
Produce a structurally incomplete transition that the schema accepts while omitting a required CM-1023 field.
Show that a verified transition can pass without a predicate delta.
Show that unlocated_after_exhaustive_coverage can pass without exhaustive_reproduced coverage and retained rejection reasons.
